in_sanskrit.name: च्छोतुराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'च्छोत' (Chhota) meaning 'small' and 'राम' (Ram) meaning 'God Rama'. Thus, the name signifies 'Small God Rama'.

in_hindi.name: चोतूराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'चोतूराम' in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'च्छोत' (Chhota) meaning 'small' and 'राम' (Ram) meaning 'God Rama'. Hence, it translates to 'Small God Rama' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: சோத்துராம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'சோத்துராம்' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'च्छोत' (Chhota) meaning 'small' and 'राम' (Ram) meaning 'God Rama'. Thus, it signifies 'Small God Rama' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: చొట్టురామ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'చొట్టురామ్' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'च्छोत' (Chhota) meaning 'small' and 'राम' (Ram) meaning 'God Rama'. Therefore, it translates to 'Small God Rama' in Telugu.
